entry_item.definition: n. Great Khan, emperor, king [cf. xan. Both of these two forms occur in Mongolian literature more or less interchangeably, and are rendered into English as Khan. However in modern usage xaγan is used only for the Great Khan or for a foreign sovereign while xan is applied to lesser Khans].

example.definition: To make one a khan; to enthrone an emperor.
The emperor himself, the emperor in person.
Power, authority, or will of an emperor.
King of Hell, judge of the dead.
